githubCodeSearch.coverageStatement: Retrieved hits are FILE matches, not repos: 54,716 retrieved file-hits deduped to 18,790 unique repos. The API total_counts are also file counts (marketplace.json 90,880; plugin.json 34,752), and the SKILL.md total_count (7,880,704) is an inflated API estimate, so a repo-level coverage ratio against total_count is not well-defined. What is structurally true: GitHub Code Search exposes at most the best-match 1,000 results per query window, so even with 96 partitioned windows the deep tail — repos whose matching files never rank in any partition's top 1,000 — is unreachable through this API. The shard design (path segments, languages, size bands, fork/archived splits) maximizes unique-repo yield per window; full enumeration of the tail would require a different index (e.g. GH Archive / BigQuery public dataset), not more Code Search calls.
githubCodeSearch.knownDefect: Window plugin::base hit HTTP 408 (ghapi timeouts on deep pages) twice and retrieved 900/1,000 hits; its shard windows (18,824 hits across the plugin shards) cover the tail substantially.
githubCodeSearch.nominated: All 18,790 unique repos nominated into the funnel with {via: github-code-search, query/shard, hitCount} provenance (run 1 landed 16,875 before a D1 import-lock crash; a --resume pass processed the remaining 1,690: 1,679 created, 11 corroborated; 17,100 already-landed locators skipped).
githubCodeSearch.shardDesign: Per base query: base window + 18 path shards + 4 size shards + 7 language shards + fork:true / fork:only / archived:true / archived:false splits = 32 windows per base query, 96 windows total; per_page=100 paginated to the API's 1,000-result window ceiling.
